b1-18-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Voting Late
b1-18-01.scenario: Károly asks Meg what she saw on the news about the parliament last night. You (Meg) say that although it was late in the evening, the representatives continued the voting.
b1-18-01.prompt: Tell Károly what the representatives did in spite of the late hour.
cues: Say what the late hour did not stop
b1-18-01.target: Annak ellenére, hogy késő este volt, a képviselők folytatták a szavazást.
b1-18-01.english: Although it was late in the evening, the representatives continued the voting.
b1-18-01.canDo: I can say what happened in spite of something, with annak ellenére, hogy and bár.

b1-18-02.title: Communicative Challenge: In Vain
b1-18-02.scenario: Petra asks Meg what happened to the proposal she read about at lunch. You (Meg) say that the representatives argued in vain, and that the proposal was not adopted.
b1-18-02.prompt: Tell Petra what the representatives did in vain and what happened to the proposal.
cues: Say that the arguing was in vain
Say what happened to the proposal
b1-18-02.target: Hiába érveltek a képviselők, a javaslatot nem fogadták el.
b1-18-02.english: No matter how much the representatives argued, the proposal was not adopted.
b1-18-02.canDo: I can say that an effort was in vain with hiába.

b1-18-03.title: Communicative Challenge: An Agreement at Last
b1-18-03.scenario: Anna asks Meg how the long public debate ended. You (Meg) say that the groups finally reached an agreement and that both sides had to make concessions.
b1-18-03.prompt: Tell Anna how the debate ended.
cues: Say that the groups reached an agreement
Say what both sides had to do
b1-18-03.target: A frakciók végül megállapodásra jutottak. Mindkét oldalnak engedményeket kellett tennie.
b1-18-03.english: The groups finally reached an agreement. Both sides had to make concessions.
b1-18-03.canDo: I can say that parties reach an agreement or make a concession, with megállapodásra jut and engedményt tesz.

b1-18-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Rights and Duties
b1-18-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg what a citizen may and must do. You (Meg) say that every citizen has the right to take part in the elections, and that it is a citizen's duty to keep the laws.
b1-18-04.prompt: Tell Károly what a citizen has the right to do and what is a duty.
cues: Say what a citizen has the right to do
Say what a citizen's duty is
b1-18-04.target: Minden állampolgárnak joga van ahhoz, hogy részt vegyen a választásokon. Kötelessége, hogy betartsa a törvényeket.
b1-18-04.english: Every citizen has the right to take part in the elections. It is their duty to keep the laws.
b1-18-04.canDo: I can say what rights and duties citizens have, with joga van ahhoz, hogy and kötelessége, hogy.

b1-18-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Agreeing Up to a Point
b1-18-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she thinks about a proposal in the news. You (Meg) say that you agree that reforms are necessary, but that there is still a debate about the details.
b1-18-05.prompt: Tell Petra what you agree with and what is still open.
b1-18-05.target: Egyetértek azzal, hogy reformokra van szükség, de a részletekben még vita van.
b1-18-05.english: I agree that reforms are necessary, but on the details there is still debate.
b1-18-05.canDo: I can agree up to a point with egyetértek azzal, hogy …, de ….

b1-18-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Funny Speech
b1-18-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg about the election speech in the story she has read. You (Meg) say that the candidate promised a bridge, and that the people laughed but said that the work is theirs.
b1-18-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly what the candidate promised and how the people reacted.
b1-18-consolidation.target: A jelölt hidat ígért. Az emberek nevettek, de azt mondták, hogy a munka az övék.
b1-18-consolidation.english: The candidate promised a bridge. The people laughed, but said that the work is theirs.
b1-18-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about parliament, elections and citizens' rights in a few sentences.
